method: Whole-file manual read of5files; pinned Git byte verification; vcxproj parsed as XML. No build/download executed.
findings: vcxproj defines Debug/Release for Win32/x64/ARM64, v145MSVC toolset, C++23, Unicode and no MFC. Windows SDK/ATL/COM/GDI/Shell/BCrypt/MTP/WMI dependencies in pch make original complete app Windows-specific; standalone extracted controls are not portable-app proof.

DownloadXXHash target queries GitHub releases/latest, falls back tov0.8.3, then downloads missing header/source from selected tag without checksum verification. Existing file left untouched, so separately missing members could derive from different versions. Commit pin alone does not freeze this generated dependency.
Prebuild executes source-formatting and string-compression scripts. Building can mutate checkout and generated resource files; these scripts still require review. No MSBuild invoked.
Release enables /Ob3, whole-program/LTCG, COMDAT folding and /OPT:ICF=8. This further limits earlier inference that missing MAP symbols prove inlining alone; no runtime speed attribution.

FloatingPointModelFast applies in common compile settings. Earlier extracted double-load NaN control used clang-O0 without fast-math, so source-method behavior cannot qualify actual MSVC optimized build behavior. Retain this restriction alongside v21control.

Version header at pinned source declares2.9.1, uses GIT_COUNT for build number with fallback deadbeef/date0 metadata and defaults PRODUCTION0. This is pinned-source metadata, not latest release/version claim.
Constants define binary Ki/Mi/Gi/Ti as powers1024 and pipe delimiter. Manifest/DPI options reference separate manifest; no platform minimum-support conclusion from WINVER7macros alone.
limits: No dependency download, source-format script, resource generation, MSVC build, Windows execution or release qualification.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred.
